defs.def: a dramatic work in which all or most of the words are sung to music; works of this type as an art form or entertainment 歌剧；歌剧剧本；歌剧艺术

ex.s: 6. ________ back to the 18th century, Peking Opera has over two hundred years of history.
ex.t: 6. ________追溯到18世纪，京剧已有两百多年的历史。

ex.s: I want to see the Peking Opera.
Having seen quite a few productions of Hamlet and read the play many times, I was full of confidence - until the Peking Opera came to town!
ex.t: 看过不少版本的《哈姆雷特》演出，也多次读过剧本，我本来信心满满——直到京剧来到镇上！

ex.s: To find out the answer, I just had to go and see The Revenge of Prince Zidan - the Peking Opera vision of Hamlet.
ex.t: 为了找到答案，我只好去看了《紫丹王子的复仇》--《哈姆雷特》的京剧幻象。

ex.s: Using such techniques, the opera had transformed a small stage into the whole universe.
ex.t: 运用这样的技巧，这部歌剧将一个小舞台变成了整个宇宙。

defs.def: a company that performs opera; a building in which operas are performed 歌剧团；歌剧院

ex.s: (Picture) 1 To prove that Peking Opera is a better way to perform Hamlet.
ex.t: （图）1 为了证明京剧是演绎《哈姆雷特》的更好方式。
